site.name: Nasdaq Volatility Screener
site.description: A market dashboard for selected Nasdaq-listed stocks, with quote metrics, volatility, VWAP, intraday charts, and optional AI-generated analysis.

pages.name: Screener
pages.description: Stock cards for NVDA, MU, GOOGL, META, MRNA, and HUT show quote metrics and optional LONG, SHORT, or NEUTRAL analysis.

pages.name: Chart view
pages.description: Intraday candlestick and volume charts for supported stocks, with 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, and 4h intervals.

data_limitations: Quote and chart data may come from different providers.
Chart history uses Yahoo Finance's unofficial chart endpoint; availability, freshness, and historical coverage are not guaranteed.
Charts refresh periodically and are not a streaming quote feed.
AI-generated analysis may be inaccurate or outdated and is not financial advice or a guarantee of future performance.
